integer n, i, j, k, x, y, bin, marg
integer ord(5), fbin(5), nbin(5), hashi(5)
double precision v(5), lo(5), hi(5), d

# test index: 1 RDS, 2 VDD, 3 FMAX, 4 ILEAK, 5 VTH
# check order by priority: FMAX, VDD, RDS, ILEAK, VTH
ord(1) = 3
ord(2) = 2
ord(3) = 1
ord(4) = 4
ord(5) = 5

# low limit, has high limit flag, high limit, fail bin, not-measured bin (0 = skip)
lo(1) = 144.783d0
hashi(1) = 0
hi(1) = 0d0
fbin(1) = 27
nbin(1) = 34

lo(2) = 44.244d0
hashi(2) = 1
hi(2) = 57.356d0
fbin(2) = 21
nbin(2) = 34

lo(3) = 211.279d0
hashi(3) = 1
hi(3) = 266.253d0
fbin(3) = 32
nbin(3) = 0

lo(4) = 312.485d0
hashi(4) = 1
hi(4) = 527.767d0
fbin(4) = 24
nbin(4) = 34

lo(5) = 368.162d0
hashi(5) = 0
hi(5) = 0d0
fbin(5) = 15
nbin(5) = 34

read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(j), j = 1, 5)
  bin = 0
  do k = 1, 5 {
    j = ord(k)
    if (bin == 0 & v(j) == -9999d0) bin = nbin(j)
    if (bin == 0 & v(j) != -9999d0) {
      if ((v(j) < lo(j)) | ((hashi(j) == 1) & (v(j) > hi(j)))) bin = fbin(j)
    }
  }
  if (bin == 0) {
    marg = 0
    do j = 1, 5 {
      if (v(j) != -9999d0) {
        d = abs(v(j) - lo(j))
        if (d <= 0.1d0 * abs(lo(j)) + 1d-9) marg = 1
        if (hashi(j) == 1) {
          d = abs(v(j) - hi(j))
          if (d <= 0.1d0 * abs(hi(j)) + 1d-9) marg = 1
        }
      }
    }
    if (marg == 1) {
      bin = 10
    } else {
      bin = 1
    }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, j, k, t, x, y, bin, marg
integer fb(3), ord(3)
double precision v(3), lo(3), hi(3), tol

# column order: 1 IDDQ, 2 FMAX, 3 VDD
lo(1) = 376.044d0
hi(1) = 517.376d0
fb(1) = 33
lo(2) = 107.095d0
hi(2) = 159.905d0
fb(2) = 30
lo(3) = 12.444d0
hi(3) = 19.156d0
fb(3) = 32

# priority order: VDD (1), FMAX (2), IDDQ (3)
ord(1) = 3
ord(2) = 2
ord(3) = 1

read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(k), k = 1, 3)
  bin = 0
  j = 1
  while (j <= 3) {
    t = ord(j)
    if (v(t) == -9999d0) { bin = 26; break }
    if (v(t) < lo(t) | v(t) > hi(t)) { bin = fb(t); break }
    j = j + 1
  }
  if (bin == 0) {
    marg = 0
    do k = 1, 3 {
      tol = 0.02d0 * abs(lo(k))
      if (abs(v(k) - lo(k)) <= tol) marg = 1
      tol = 0.02d0 * abs(hi(k))
      if (abs(v(k) - hi(k)) <= tol) marg = 1
    }
    if (marg == 1) bin = 15
    else bin = 1
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, x, y, bin
double precision iddq, vdd
read(5,*) n
for (i = 1; i <= n; i = i + 1) {
  read(5,*) x, y, iddq, vdd
  bin = 1
  if (vdd == -9999d0) bin = 21
  else if (vdd > 553.807d0) bin = 12
  else if (iddq == -9999d0) bin = 21
  else if (iddq > 378.02d0) bin = 25
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, x, y, b
double precision iddq, vdd
read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, iddq, vdd
  b = 1
  # priority 1: VDD (high limit only)
  if (vdd == -9999d0) b = 21
  else if (vdd > 553.807d0) b = 12
  # priority 2: IDDQ (high limit only)
  else if (iddq == -9999d0) b = 21
  else if (iddq > 378.02d0) b = 25
  write(6,*) x, y, b
}
end

integer n, i, j, k, x, y, bin, done, mg
integer ord(4), fb(4), nb(4)
double precision v(4), lo(4), hi(4)

# test order by priority: GAIN(3), RDS(2), TEMP(1), ILEAK(4)
ord(1) = 3
ord(2) = 2
ord(3) = 1
ord(4) = 4

lo(1) = 241.542d0
hi(1) = 302.676d0
lo(2) = 83.229d0
hi(2) = 99.671d0
lo(3) = 283.243d0
hi(3) = 334.557d0
lo(4) = 79.118d0
hi(4) = 1d300

fb(1) = 3
fb(2) = 31
fb(3) = 17
fb(4) = 5

# not-measured bin; -1 means skip
nb(1) = 12
nb(2) = -1
nb(3) = -1
nb(4) = 12

read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(k), k = 1, 4)
  bin = 0
  done = 0
  for (j = 1; j <= 4 & done == 0; j = j + 1) {
    k = ord(j)
    if (v(k) == -9999d0) {
      if (nb(k) < 0) next
      bin = nb(k)
      done = 1
    } else if (v(k) < lo(k) | v(k) > hi(k)) {
      bin = fb(k)
      done = 1
    }
  }
  if (done == 0) {
    mg = 0
    for (k = 1; k <= 4; k = k + 1) {
      if (v(k) != -9999d0) {
        if (abs(v(k) - lo(k)) <= 0.1d0 * abs(lo(k))) mg = 1
        if (abs(v(k) - hi(k)) <= 0.1d0 * abs(hi(k))) mg = 1
      }
    }
    if (mg == 1) bin = 9
    else bin = 1
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, r, k, i, x, y, bin
integer ord(4), fb(4), nm(4)
double precision t(4), lo(4), hi(4)

# test order by priority: GAIN, RDS, TEMP, ILEAK
ord(1) = 3
ord(2) = 2
ord(3) = 1
ord(4) = 4

# fail bins and not-measured bins per column (0 = skip)
fb(1) = 3
fb(2) = 31
fb(3) = 17
fb(4) = 5
nm(1) = 12
nm(2) = 0
nm(3) = 0
nm(4) = 12

# limits; hi = 1d30 stands for "no upper limit"
lo(1) = 241.542d0
hi(1) = 302.676d0
lo(2) = 83.229d0
hi(2) = 99.671d0
lo(3) = 283.243d0
hi(3) = 334.557d0
lo(4) = 79.118d0
hi(4) = 1d30

read(5,*) n
for (r = 1; r <= n; r = r + 1) {
  read(5,*) x, y, t(1), t(2), t(3), t(4)
  bin = 0
  for (k = 1; k <= 4; k = k + 1) {
    i = ord(k)
    if (t(i) == -9999d0) {
      if (nm(i) == 0) next
      bin = nm(i)
      break
    }
    if (t(i) < lo(i) | t(i) > hi(i)) {
      bin = fb(i)
      break
    }
  }
  if (bin == 0) {
    bin = 1
    for (i = 1; i <= 4; i = i + 1) {
      if (t(i) != -9999d0) {
        if (abs(t(i) - lo(i)) <= 0.1d0 * abs(lo(i)) | abs(t(i) - hi(i)) <= 0.1d0 * abs(hi(i)))
          bin = 9
      }
    }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, j, t, bin, done, x, y
integer ord(4), hasl(4), hasu(4), fl(4), nb(4), sk(4)
double precision v(4), lo(4), hi(4), tol

# priority order: VTH, FMAX, TEMP, VDD
ord(1) = 2
ord(2) = 1
ord(3) = 3
ord(4) = 4

# test 1: FMAX
hasl(1) = 0
lo(1) = 0d0
hasu(1) = 1
hi(1) = 224.619d0
fl(1) = 6
nb(1) = 0
sk(1) = 1

# test 2: VTH
hasl(2) = 1
lo(2) = 224.154d0
hasu(2) = 1
hi(2) = 341.646d0
fl(2) = 36
nb(2) = 5
sk(2) = 0

# test 3: TEMP
hasl(3) = 1
lo(3) = 186.357d0
hasu(3) = 1
hi(3) = 210.843d0
fl(3) = 8
nb(3) = 0
sk(3) = 1

# test 4: VDD
hasl(4) = 1
lo(4) = 58.608d0
hasu(4) = 1
hi(4) = 86.592d0
fl(4) = 25
nb(4) = 0
sk(4) = 1

read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, v(1), v(2), v(3), v(4)
  bin = 0
  done = 0
  for (j = 1; j <= 4 & done == 0; j = j + 1) {
    t = ord(j)
    if (v(t) == -9999d0) {
      if (sk(t) == 0) {
        bin = nb(t)
        done = 1
      }
    }
    else if ((hasl(t) == 1 & v(t) < lo(t)) | (hasu(t) == 1 & v(t) > hi(t))) {
      bin = fl(t)
      done = 1
    }
  }
  if (done == 0) {
    bin = 1
    for (t = 1; t <= 4; t = t + 1) {
      if (v(t) != -9999d0) {
        if (hasl(t) == 1) {
          tol = 0.02d0 * abs(lo(t))
          if (abs(v(t) - lo(t)) <= tol) bin = 34
        }
        if (hasu(t) == 1) {
          tol = 0.02d0 * abs(hi(t))
          if (abs(v(t) - hi(t)) <= tol) bin = 34
        }
      }
    }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, x, y, bin, marg
double precision v(4), eps
eps = 1d-9
read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(j), j = 1, 4)
  bin = 0
  # priority 1: VTH (column 2); not measured -> bin 5
  if (v(2) == -9999d0) bin = 5
  if (bin == 0 & v(2) != -9999d0 & (v(2) < 224.154d0 | v(2) > 341.646d0)) bin = 36
  # priority 2: FMAX (column 1); not measured -> skip
  if (bin == 0 & v(1) != -9999d0 & v(1) > 224.619d0) bin = 6
  # priority 3: TEMP (column 3); not measured -> skip
  if (bin == 0 & v(3) != -9999d0 & (v(3) < 186.357d0 | v(3) > 210.843d0)) bin = 8
  # priority 4: VDD (column 4); not measured -> skip
  if (bin == 0 & v(4) != -9999d0 & (v(4) < 58.608d0 | v(4) > 86.592d0)) bin = 25
  if (bin == 0) {
    marg = 0
    if (v(1) != -9999d0 & abs(v(1) - 224.619d0) <= 0.02d0*224.619d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (v(2) != -9999d0 & abs(v(2) - 224.154d0) <= 0.02d0*224.154d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (v(2) != -9999d0 & abs(v(2) - 341.646d0) <= 0.02d0*341.646d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (v(3) != -9999d0 & abs(v(3) - 186.357d0) <= 0.02d0*186.357d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (v(3) != -9999d0 & abs(v(3) - 210.843d0) <= 0.02d0*210.843d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (v(4) != -9999d0 & abs(v(4) - 58.608d0) <= 0.02d0*58.608d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (v(4) != -9999d0 & abs(v(4) - 86.592d0) <= 0.02d0*86.592d0 + eps) marg = 1
    if (marg == 1) { bin = 34 } else { bin = 1 }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end
